name: Wei Jian Tan
bio:
Wei Jian developed a meticulous eye for detail early in life, fostered by his father's work as a watchmaker. This precision led him to excel in engineering studies at the National University of Singapore, where he specialized in materials science. His passion for motorsport ignited during a Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix, sparking a desire to apply his technical skills in the fast-paced world of racing.

After graduating, Wei Jian sought an opportunity to combine his love for engineering with his burgeoning interest in motorsport. He joined Walkenhorst Motorsport, quickly establishing himself as a competent and reliable member of the quality control team. He believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing every component and process to identify areas for improvement. His ability to see the bigger picture allows him to anticipate potential issues before they escalate, ensuring the team operates at peak performance.

Wei Jian is driven by a relentless pursuit of perfection. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to communicate complex technical information clearly and concisely. His colleagues appreciate his willingness to go the extra mile and his dedication to maintaining the highest standards of quality.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Wei Jian is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even to lunch.
Insists on using a specific brand of microfiber cloth for cleaning sensitive components.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
